mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals weakening consumer demand and rising recession risk, which increases discount rates and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE > 4.0% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 3% signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings growth and drives lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when RSAFS falls > 3% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the industrial production index above 1% signals stronger economic activity and higher earnings potential, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO rises > 1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% and a fall in payroll employment above 2% over 3 months signals a sharp labor market downturn, which increases discount rates and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4.0% AND PAYEMS falls > 2% over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both UNRATE > 4.0% and PAYEMS falls > 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 5.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS > 5.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing starts index above 10% signals weakening residential investment and lower economic growth, which reduces S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST falls > 10% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 2% signals stronger demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when RSAFS rises > 2% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
